program:
alphabet a b

is_bos = bos
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j | !is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & is_b@j, true)
h1_2 = leftmost(!is_a@i & is_b@i & !is_bos@j, is_a@j & !is_b@j)
accept = !is_bos & is_b & !h1_2 | is_a & !is_b & !h1_1 & !h1_2

output accept
